column5: def MatchingLogic.VariantOneCopy.V1Claim : Prop := ∀ (S : MatchingLogic.Signature) (Var : Type) (x : DecidableEq Var) (M : MatchingLogic.Model S) (C : Set M.carrier), M.BackwardClosed C → ∀ (hne : C.Nonempty), ∀ star ∉ C, ∀ (ψ : MatchingLogic.Pattern S Var) (ν : Var → ↑C × Bool) (p : ↑C × Bool), p ∈ (MatchingLogic.VariantOneCopy.cover₁ M C hne).denote ν ψ ↔ ↑p.1 ∈ M.denote (fun x => MatchingLogic.proj M C star p.2 (ν x)) ψ

def MatchingLogic.VariantMixed.V2Claim : Prop := ∀ (S : MatchingLogic.Signature) (Var : Type) (x : DecidableEq Var) (M : MatchingLogic.Model S) (C : Set M.carrier), M.BackwardClosed C → ∀ (hne : C.Nonempty), ∀ star ∉ C, ∀ (ψ : MatchingLogic.Pattern S Var) (ν : Var → ↑C × Bool) (p : ↑C × Bool), p ∈ (MatchingLogic.VariantMixed.cover₂ M C hne).denote ν ψ ↔ ↑p.1 ∈ M.denote (fun x => MatchingLogic.proj M C star p.2 (ν x)) ψ

def MatchingLogic.VariantWeakAgree.V3Claim : Prop := ∀ (S : MatchingLogic.Signature) (Var : Type) (x : DecidableEq Var) (M : MatchingLogic.Model S) (C : Set M.carrier), M.BackwardClosed C → ∀ (ψ : MatchingLogic.Pattern S Var) (ρ ρ' : Var → M.carrier), MatchingLogic.VariantWeakAgree.AgreeOnWeak C ρ ρ' → M.denote ρ ψ ∩ C = M.denote ρ' ψ ∩ C

def MatchingLogic.VariantStepDirection.V4Claim : Prop := ∀ (S : MatchingLogic.Signature) (Var : Type) (x : DecidableEq Var) (M : MatchingLogic.Model S) (C : Set M.carrier), MatchingLogic.VariantStepDirection.ForwardClosed M C → ∀ (ψ : MatchingLogic.Pattern S Var) (ρ ρ' : Var → M.carrier), MatchingLogic.AgreeOn C ρ ρ' → M.denote ρ ψ ∩ C = M.denote ρ' ψ ∩ C

def MatchingLogic.VariantSingleSheet.V5Claim : Prop := ∀ (S : MatchingLogic.Signature) (Var : Type) (x : DecidableEq Var) (M : MatchingLogic.Model S) (C : Set M.carrier), M.BackwardClosed C → ∀ (hne : C.Nonempty), ∀ star ∉ C, ∀ (ψ : MatchingLogic.Pattern S Var), MatchingLogic.Closed ψ → ∀ (ρ : Var → M.carrier), (MatchingLogic.VariantSingleSheet.single M C hne).Sat ψ ↔ C ⊆ M.denote ρ ψ
